integrity: Analytical derivation of two-lineage hitting probabilities, supported by finite exact-rational calculations; no external independent audit, certification, or priority determination.
scientific_limitations: This exact two-point result concerns infinite homogeneous trees of degree at least three, homogeneous finite nonzero broadcast measures, and the stationary weak limit from i.i.d. Bernoulli initial laws. It does not determine higher-order marginals, arbitrary invariant laws, or irregular graphs. Classical voter duality and general stationary existence are prior results.
title: Exact stationary two-point correlations for broadcast voters on regular trees
